description.value:
“The garden ate itself a long time ago. You eat it back.”

Wasteland Bound. You have reroll the lowest die on Soul (Athletics (Violence) (Violence) (Body)) checks [TODO(adv-call)] made to navigate, scavenge, or endure irradiated, tainted, or otherwise unstable environments.

Hardened Hide. You have resistance to one of the following damage types of your choice (declared at character creation, permanent): poison, radiant, or necrotic.

Restless Dreaming. You only need 4 hours of light trance to gain the benefit of a Soma Break. While in this trance you remain dimly aware of your surroundings.
